examples.arabic: إمبارح شغلّت مزيكا حلوة عشان أروّق دماغي، وكانت أغاني قديمة كتير عجبتني.
examples.english: Yesterday I played beautiful music to clear my head, and they were many old songs that I liked.
examples.transliteration: Embareh shaghghalt mazeeka ḥelwa ʾashan ʾarawwaʾ demaghi, we kanet ʾaghani ʾadeema keteir ʾagabetny.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: احنا قاعدين كلنا في الصالة بنسمع اغاني قديمة
examples.english: We are all sitting in the living room listening to old songs.

examples.arabic: سارة بتحب الاغاني والموسيقى العالية قوي
examples.english: Sara loves very loud songs and music.

examples.arabic: لكن الشباب كانوا عايزين اغاني جديدة ويرقصوا
examples.english: But the youth wanted new songs and to dance.
examples.transliteration: Laken el shabab kanu ayzin aghani gedida w yor'osu.

examples.english: We are all happy and singing nice songs.
